title: Introducir un tema
use: Primer párrafo de essays, informes y propuestas: presenta el tema y su relevancia sin copiar el enunciado.
phrases: In recent years, there has been growing concern about...
Few issues have generated as much debate as...
... has become one of the most pressing challenges of our time.
The question of whether... has long divided opinion.
This essay will examine two possible approaches to...
The aim of this report is to...
The purpose of this proposal is to outline...

title: Dar una opinión (formal)
use: Para expresar tu postura en essays, cartas y memos con un registro formal, evitando el repetitivo "I think".
phrases: There can be little doubt that...
I am inclined to believe that...
To my mind, the strongest argument is...
I strongly support the proposal to...

title: Matizar (hedging)
use: Para suavizar afirmaciones y sonar prudente y académico; muy valorado en C1 y en informes técnicos donde no hay certeza total.
phrases: This may well be due to...
There is some evidence to suggest that...
This could, arguably, be seen as...
The most likely cause appears to be...
It is not entirely clear whether...

title: Añadir ideas
use: Para encadenar argumentos del mismo signo. Varía los conectores en lugar de repetir "and" o "also".
phrases: Not only does..., but it also...
Equally important is the fact that...

title: Contrastar y conceder
use: Para presentar contraargumentos y refutarlos; imprescindible para un essay equilibrado y para memos SLP.
phrases: Despite / In spite of the fact that...
It could be argued that... However, ...

title: Causa y consecuencia
use: Para explicar por qué ocurre algo y qué resultados tiene; muy útil en informes técnicos y de incidentes.
phrases: owing to / due to / on account of
The main reason for this is that...

title: Poner ejemplos
use: Para apoyar argumentos con ejemplos concretos, algo que eleva la puntuación en "content" y "communicative achievement".

title: Concluir
use: Último párrafo: resume y responde explícitamente a la pregunta del enunciado. No introduzcas ideas nuevas.
phrases: Weighing up both sides, I believe that...
It is therefore my view that...

title: Recomendar (informes y propuestas)
use: Sección de recomendaciones de reports, proposals, technical reports y memos. Fíjate en el subjuntivo ("be", sin -s).
phrases: In the light of these findings, ...
The most cost-effective solution would be to...

title: Describir datos y tendencias
use: Para informes técnicos, resúmenes ejecutivos y presentaciones: describir cifras, gráficos y evolución.
phrases: ... rose sharply / increased steadily from... to...
There was a significant increase in...
roughly / approximately / just over / well below
a third / the vast majority / a small minority of...
compared with the same period last year
an estimated 31 MWh of energy not supplied
by a factor of two / twofold

title: Aperturas y cierres de emails formales
use: Inicio y final de emails y cartas formales. "Yours faithfully" si no conoces el nombre; "Yours sincerely" si lo conoces.
phrases: Dear Sir or Madam, / Dear Inspector Larsen,
I am writing to enquire about...
I am writing in response to...
I am writing with regard to...
Further to our telephone conversation of...
Thank you for your email of 3 October.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Please do not hesitate to contact me should you require further information.
Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
Yours faithfully, / Yours sincerely, / Kind regards,

title: Hacer peticiones con cortesía
use: Para solicitar información o acciones en emails formales, cooperación internacional o con proveedores.
phrases: I would be grateful if you could...
I would appreciate it if you could...
I wonder whether you might be able to...
I should be most grateful for...
It would be very helpful if you could provide...
May I ask you to confirm...?
If it is not too much trouble, ...

title: Quejas y reclamaciones
use: Emails a proveedores (no conformidades) o cartas de queja: firmeza profesional sin agresividad.
phrases: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with...
I regret to inform you that...
Our inspection identified the following non-conformities:
This falls well short of the standard specified in...
As a consequence, we are unable to...
This situation has caused considerable inconvenience / delay.
We must therefore ask you to...
Failing this, we will have no alternative but to...
We trust that this matter will be resolved promptly.

title: Reseñas: elogiar y criticar
use: Para reviews (Part 2): valoraciones matizadas con adjetivos y estructuras enfáticas.
phrases: Where the series really excels is...
It is visually stunning / gripping / thought-provoking.
The plot is fast-paced and keeps you on the edge of your seat.
If I had one criticism, it would be that...
It falls short of expectations in terms of...
somewhat predictable / overly technical / rather superficial
I would wholeheartedly recommend it to...
It is well worth watching, if only for...
Fans of... will not be disappointed.

title: Encabezados y estructura de informes
use: Esqueletos de encabezados para reports, proposals, technical reports, executive summaries y memos.

title: Redacción técnica: pasiva y nominalización
use: Para informes técnicos y de ingeniería: estilo impersonal, objetivo y denso en información.
phrases: The conveyor was isolated and the area was cordoned off.
It was established / found / observed that...
The failure of the termination resulted in...
The implementation of the procedure is scheduled for...
Isolation must be applied before any intervention.
is subject to / in accordance with / in compliance with
Failure to apply lockout led to...

title: Lenguaje de informe policial
use: Atestados, informes de incidentes y briefings: cronología precisa, lenguaje neutro y objetivo, sin juicios.
phrases: The subject was observed leaving the premises...
The vehicle was stopped and searched.
The individual was detained / arrested on suspicion of...
The suspect was described as a male, approximately 30 years of age...
Evidence was recovered, bagged, labelled and logged.
The chain of custody was maintained throughout.
A statement was taken from the witness.
The area was secured and a cordon established.
The matter has been referred to...
